content.text:
I'll go screen by screen, the way I'd scroll.

**Screen 1**
- "קרן השתלמות" is the heading. Good, that's exactly what I came for.
- "חיסכון שהמעסיק ואתם מפקידים אליו מהשכר", so it's savings, and the employer puts money in too.
- "המעסיק עד 7.5%", "ועד 2.5% מכם". So the employer puts in three times what I do. That's a lot.
- "6 שנים אחרי התשלום הראשון אפשר למשוך הכול בפטור ממס; לפני כן משיכה אפשרית, אבל ממוסה". So the answer is six years, and before that I'd pay tax.
- "הכסף מושקע במסלול השקעה" worries me a little. Lower down are "S&P 500 מדד" and "מסלול כללי". At least there's also "אג"ח ממשלתית", and those I know are safe.

**Screen 2**
- "מה מייחד": S, and P, 500. Then "מחקה", "13245", "דמי ניהול 0.54%". I don't follow this.
- There's a bar to drag ("גררו את הסמן") with "נעול: משיכה ממוסה" up to 6 and "אפשר למשוך בפטור" after it. The picture says the same: six years. I'm not touching the slider.

**Screen 3**
- Lots of numbers. 415.84 ₪, 2,402.23, 2,922.17, 23,692.
- "342.02−". A minus. I stopped there.
- Useful line: "למי שהגיע לגיל פרישה... רק 3 שנים". At my age, maybe only three years? I'm not sure that applies to me.
- "התשואה... 7% בשנה... הנחות של האתר, לא תחזית". So it isn't a promise.

**Screen 4**
- "מתי הכסף פנוי: כשעוברות 6 שנים", in big letters. Clear.
- "תוך כמה זמן הכסף אצלכם: עד 4 ימי עסקים".
- Run by "חברות מנהלות של קופות גמל". There are codes like TXH-09 and KH-15 that I don't understand.

**Screen 5**
- "כמה זה עולה": "דמי ניהול... עד 2% בשנה" every year, on all the money. Two percent is a lot!
- "דמי יציאה: אין". Fine.
- Names I know: הפניקס, הראל, אלטשולר שחם.

**Screen 6**
- An orange box: "משיכה לפני הזמן אפשרית, אבל יקרה... 47%". So don't touch it before six years.
- "אין ערבות של המדינה לשווי הקרן", and "השווי עולה ויורד". That isn't like a deposit.

I'm tired now and there are too many numbers. I'll stop here.

---

**What I'd tell my son:**
"Listen, here's what I understood. A keren hishtalmut is savings out of my salary. The employer puts in up to 7.5% and I put in 2.5%. After six years I can take everything out tax-free. Before that I can take it, but it's expensive. They even wrote 47% in an orange box. Because the employer adds three times what I put in, it does sound worth having, and I'll probably say yes.

But it isn't a deposit. It says plainly 'אין ערבות של המדינה' and 'השווי עולה ויורד'. The management fee can be up to 2% a year. So I want you, or the clerk at the bank, to help me pick the safe track. I saw 'אג"ח ממשלתית', not the S, and, P one. Something also said that for someone at retirement age it might be only three years. I'm not sure that's me, so ask about that too.

I read the first six screens. After the part about risks I stopped. Too many numbers, and I didn't reach the bottom.

Things I didn't understand: S&P 500, מחקה, מסלול כללי, מק"מ, הפקדה מוטבת, ריאלי, נאמנות. The codes like TXH-09, KH-22 and PF-06. Why some words have dotted lines under them.

I got stuck on the minus 342.02 and on that slider with the stripes. The grey lines under the boxes, like 'ההכנסה: דוגמה של האתר', were hard to read. The text is pale on black.

Also, who is this 'מקור'? I've never heard of it. I wouldn't give them money. I'd only use it for reading."

input.answer: A keren hishtalmut is savings from my salary: the employer adds up to 7.5% and I add 2.5%, and after 6 years I can take it all out without tax, but before that it's taxed and expensive. It sounds worth having because of the employer's part, but it isn't a guaranteed deposit, so I'll ask my son or the bank to help me pick the safest track and check the fees.
